commands.name: p06_dependency_local_prepare-help
commands.stdout:
usage: p06_dependency_local_prepare.py [-h] [--source-dir SOURCE_DIR]
                                       --workspace-dir WORKSPACE_DIR
                                       --expected-revision EXPECTED_REVISION
                                       --archive-root ARCHIVE_ROOT
                                       --dependency-repositories
                                       DEPENDENCY_REPOSITORIES
                                       [--host-bin HOST_BIN]

Prepare fresh dependencies from explicit local Git objects and locked
archives.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-dir SOURCE_DIR
  --workspace-dir WORKSPACE_DIR
  --expected-revision EXPECTED_REVISION
  --archive-root ARCHIVE_ROOT
  --dependency-repositories DEPENDENCY_REPOSITORIES
  --host-bin HOST_BIN

commands.name: p06_dependency_build-help
commands.stdout:
usage: p06_dependency_build.py [-h] [--source-dir SOURCE_DIR] --workspace-dir
                               WORKSPACE_DIR --preparation PREPARATION
                               --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR --expected-revision
                               EXPECTED_REVISION [--host-bin HOST_BIN]

Build and stage the three selected SimX dependencies from fresh locked
sources.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-dir SOURCE_DIR
  --workspace-dir WORKSPACE_DIR
  --preparation PREPARATION
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR

                        preparation
